items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1960-03-29
items.q: The interviewee states 'Cousin of mine' in response to a question about Willie Parker, but Joe Robichaud is only mentioned by the interviewer as being present at an event ('Joe Robichaud was there in the second line'). The interviewee does not mention a personal relationship with Robichaud.

ctx.x: About a year, about a year, year, year and a half. About a year and a half.

So that's right up to now. It was summer before last. Mm-hmm. It was summer before last. It was a hot day, I remember. Joe Robichaud was there in the second line. I left early. I was lucky. Well, was there much difference in the second line in different parts of town? It was all the same.
